name: Nandita Samanta

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nandita Samanta is a poet, short-story writer, reviewer and artist whose practice brings words and visual expression together. Her collections include Scattered Moments and The Trapeze of the Mind. Her work also extends to translation and book-cover illustration; Bobbling Inner Bubbles pairs poems with paintings.

Her poems here consider how we carry experience through time. ‘I Walk Within Me’ makes memory an inward landscape of streets, roots and returning farewells. ‘Realization’ follows the gradual movement through loss into renewed life, as seasons pass and an experience becomes a story. Both poems attend to change without suggesting that the past simply disappears.
